verses.en: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
verses.sm: Iesu Ua mavae po e lua ona oo lea i le paseka, ma areto e le faafefeteina; ona saili lea e le au ositaulaga sili ma le au tusiupu, pe faapefea sa latou mailei e pue ai ia te ia, ma fasiotia.

verses.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.sm: A ua latou faapea ane, “Aua le faia i le tausamiga, ne“ faanunununu ai le nuu.”

verses.en: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
verses.sm: Sa i Petania o ia i le fale o Simona le lepela, o taoto i le taumafataga, ona sau lea o le fafine ma le fagu alapasa, ua i ai le uu nato tau tele; ua tatae le fagu, ma liligi ai i luga o lona ao.

verses.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.sm: Sa i ai nisi na tiga aio latou loto, ma latou faapea ane, “Pe se a le mea ua maumau ai faapea le uu manogi?

verses.en: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.sm: Aua ana faatauina lena mea, po ua maua ai tenari e tolu selau ma ona tupu, e foaiina atu ai i e matitiva.” Ona latou muimui lea i le fafine.

verses.en: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu Iesu, “Tuupea ia ia te ia; se a le mea tou te faalavelave ai ia te ia? O le mea lelei ua faia e ia ia te au nei.

verses.en: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.sm: Auà tou te nonofo pea ma e matitiva, o aso uma foi tou te loto i ai ua outou mafaia ona agalelei atu ia te i latou; a o a‘u nei, tatou te le nonofo pea ma outou.

verses.en: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.sm: Ua faia e ia le mea ua ia mafai ai; ua na uuina loʻu tino e fai ma faataimuaga o lo‘u tanuga.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o nuu uma lava i le lalolagi e tala“ima i ai lenei tala lelei, e taʻua ai foi lenei mea ua faia e ia, e faamanatu a“ ia te ia.”

verses.en: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.sm: to Ona alu lea o Iuta le Sekara, o le tasi o le toatinoagafulu ma le toalua, i le au ositaulaga sili, e faalataina ai o ia ia te i latou.

verses.en: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.sm: Ua latou faalogo ai, ona fiafia lea, ma latou folafola ni tupe ia te ia; ona lamalama lea e ia o se itu aso e faigofie ai ona faalataina o ia.

verses.en: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.sm: O le aso muamua o areto e le faafefeteina, e osi ai le paseka, ua fai mai ai ona soo ia te ia, “Po o fea e te finagalo i ai, matou te o e sauni e te taumafa ai le paseka?”

verses.en: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.sm: Ona aau atu lea e ia o ona soo etoalua, ma na fetalai atu ia te i laua, “Ina o ia oulua i le aai, tou te fetaiai ai ma le tagata o ave le vai omea, lua te mulimuli atu ia te ia;

verses.en: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.sm: e iloga foi le mea na te ulufale atu i ai, fai ane ia i le matai o le aiga, O loo fai mai le aʻoaʻo, O ifea loʻu afeafe, ou te ‘ai ai le paseka ma oʻu soo?

verses.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.sm: Na te faaali ane ia te oulua le afeafe tele e aupito i luga, ua uma ona teu; lua te sauni ai mo i tatou.”

verses.en: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.sm: Ona o atu ai lea o ona soo, ua oo i le aai, ua iloa atu ai foi e pei ona fetalai atu ai o ia ia te ilaua; ona la sauniuni lea o le paseka.

verses.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le afiafi, ona maliu ane lea o ia ma le toatinoagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.sm: O loo taooto i latou ma aai, ona fetalai atu lea o lesu, “E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, O le tasi o outou o le ‘ai faatasi nei ma aʻu, o ia na te faalataina au.”

verses.en: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
verses.sm: Ona tiga lea o i latou, ua latou taitasi ma faapea mai ia te ia, “O aʻu ea?”

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “O le tasi o le toatinoagafulu ma le toalua, o lè fufui faatasi nei o ma lima i le tanoa.

verses.en: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.sm: E alu lava le Atalii o le tagata faapei ona tusia ia te ia; a o le tagata na te faalataina le Atalii o le tagata, oi talofa ia te ia! E lelei i lea tagata pe ana le fanau mai o ia.”

verses.en: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.sm: O lco aai i latou, a e tago Iesu i le areto, ua faafetai, ona tofitofi lea, ma avatu ai ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, “Ina tago ia, o loʻu tino lenei.”

verses.en: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.sm: Ua tago foi o ia i le ipu, ua faafetai, ma avatu ai ia te i latou, ua latou inu uma i ai.

verses.en: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.sm: Ua feralai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, “O loʻu toto lenei, o le toto ole feagaiga, ua faamaligiina mo tagata e toatele.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ou te le toe inu lava i le fua o le vine, seia oo i lea lava aso ou te inu ai le uaina fou i le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona faia o a latou pese,

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.sm: ona latou o atu lea i le mauga o Ou te tata le leoleo mamoe, ona taapeape ai lea o mamoe.

verses.en: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.sm: À e peitai a mavae loʻu toe tu, ona ou muamua atu ai lea ia te outou i Kalilaia.”

verses.en: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.sm: A ua fai mai Peteru ia te ia, “E ui lava ina tausuai o tagata uma, ou te le faapea lava aʻu.”

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, “E moni, ou te fai atu ia te oe, O lenei aso, o le po nei lava, a o lei oo ile vivini faalua o moa, e te faafiti faatolu mai ia te au.”

verses.en: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.sm: Ona atili ai lea ona fai mai o ia, “E ui lava ina ta oti faatasi ma oe, ou te le faafiti lava ia te oe.” Ua faapea foi ona fai mai o i latou uma.

verses.en: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.sm: Ua latou oo atu i le fanua, o Ketesemane lona igoa; ona fetalai atu lea o ia i ona soo, “Ina nonofo ia outou iinei, se ou tatalo.”

verses.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.sm: Ua ō ane foi o ia ma Peteru, ma Iakopo, ma Ioane, ona matautuia lea o ia, ma atuatuvale.

verses.en: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “O loo matuā tiga lava loʻu loto e oo i le oti; ina nonofo ia outou iinei, ma mataala.”

verses.en: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.sm: Ua faaitiiti atu ia i luma, ona faapaŭ lea o ia i le eleele, ma tatalo ina ia mavae atu lea itu aso ia te ia, pe afai e mafaia.

verses.en: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu, “Ava, loʻu Tama e, e te mafaia e oe mea uma lava; ia e aveeseina lenei ipu ia te au; a e aua le faia loʻu loto, a o lou finagalo.”

verses.en: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.sm: Ona maliu ane lea o ia, ua maua i latou o momoe; ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia Peteru, “Simona e, ua e moe ea? Olive. Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu E te le lavā ea ona mataala i le itu ia te i latou, “Tou te tausuai uma ona o aʻu i lenei po; aua ua tusia, po e tasi?

verses.en: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
verses.sm: Ina mataala ia, ma tatalo, neʻi 00 mai le faaosoosoga ia te outou; ua manaoiaileloto, ao le tino ua vaivai.”

verses.en: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.sm: Ua toe maliu atu o ia, ua toe tatalo, ua fetalai atu le upu lava e tasi.

verses.en: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.sm: Ua toe foi mai o ia, ua toe maua i latou o momoe, aua ua maaa o latou laumata; ua latou le iloa foi pe se a latou te tau atu ai ia te ia,

verses.en: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.sm: Ua toe foi mai o ia ia te i latou, o le atu tolu lea, ua faapea atu foi o ia ia te i latou, “Ua outou momoe pea ea, ma malolo? Soia! Ua oo mai le itu po; faauta, ua tuuina atu le Atalii o le tagata i lima o tagata agasala.

verses.en: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.sm: Ina tutù ia, ia tatou o. Faauta, ua latalata mai o ia na te faalataina au.”

verses.en: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai o ia a e sau loa Iuta, o le tasi o le toatinoagafulu ma le toalua, ua faatasi mai foi ma ia le motu o tagata e toatele mai le au ositaulaga sili, ma le au tusiupu, ma toeaina, ua ia te i latou o pelu ma uatogi.

verses.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.sm: Na tuuina atu e le na faalataina o ia le faailoga ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, “O lé ou te sogi atu i al, o ia lea; tou te pue ia te ia, ma ta'ita'iina atu, ma taofimauina.”

verses.en: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai o ia, ona soso mai loa lea ia te ia, ua fai mai, “Rapi e!” Ua sogi ane foi ia te ia.

verses.en: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.sm: Ona oo atu lea o latou lima ia te ia, ua latou pue foi ia te ia.

verses.en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.sm: O le tasi o i latou o e na twu i ai, ua ia toina lana pelu, ua ta le auauna a le ositaulaga sili, ua tipiesea lona taliga.

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Ua outou o mai ea ma pelu ma uatogi e pue mai ai la te au, pelseai se fao mea?

verses.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Sa tatou faatasi ma aʻu i le malumalu, sa ou aʻoaʻo atu ai i aso fai soo, tou te lei pucina ai aʻu.

verses.en: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.sm: A ua faila ina ia taunuu ai Tusi.” so Ona tuua ai lea o

verses.en: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.sm: ia e i latou uma, ua sosola. SI A ua mulimuli atu ia te ia le tasi taulealea, ua pulupulu lona tino i le ie lino, ua latou pue atu foi ia te ia;

verses.en: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.sm: a ua tuua e ia le ie lino, ua sola ia te i latou ua le lavalava.

verses.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.sm: Ona latou tafita‘i lea ia Iesu i le ositaulaga sili; ua potopoto uma atu foi ia te ia le au ositaulaga sili, ma toeaina, ma le au tusiupu.

verses.en: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.sm: Ua mulimuli mamao mai foi Peteru ia te ia, ua 00 lava i le maota o le ositaulaga sili; ua nofo ai i lalo faatasi ma auauna, ma mumulu i le afi.

verses.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.sm: A o le au ositaulaga sili, ma le taupulega uma, ua latou saili i mau ia Iesu, ina ia fasioti ia te ia; a e lei maua lava.

verses.en: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.sm: Aua e toatele ua latou molimau pepelo ia te ia, a e le tutusa a latou mau.

verses.en: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.sm: Ona tutu lea o isi, ma molimau pepelo ia te ia, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.sm: “Na ma faalogo atu ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Ou te lepetia lenei malumalu na faia e lima, ma ou toe faia se tasi i aso e tolu, e lei faia e lima.”

verses.en: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.sm: A ua le tutusa a la mau i lea mea.

verses.en: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.sm: Ona tu lea o le ositaulaga sili i totonu, ua fesili mai ia Iesu, “E te le tali mai ea sina upu? Pe se a le mau a nei tagata ia te oe?”

verses.en: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.sm: A ua le fetalai O ia, ua leai foi sana tali. Ona toe fesili mai lea o le ositaulaga sili ia te ia, “O oe ea o le Keriso, o le Alo o Lē Yna?”

verses.en: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu, “O au lava lea; tou te iloa foi le Atalii o le tagata c nofo i le itu taumatau o Lé eonale mana,

verses.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.sm: esaufoioiaiaoole lagi.”63 Ona saeia lea e le ositaulaga sili o ona lava ofu, ua faapea ane, “Se a ea le toe aoga ia te i tatou O molimau?

verses.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.sm: Ua outou faalogo i le upu feifai i le Atua. Pe ni a fa outou?” Ona fai mai lea o i latou uma, “E tatau ona oti o ia.”

verses.en: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.sm: Ona feanu ai lea o isi ia te ia, ma ufiufi i ona fofoga, ma tu°i ia te ia, ua faapea mai foi ia te ia, “Ina iite mai ia!” O le au auauna foi, ua latou taufaipo mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.sm: Sa i lalo Peteru i le maota; ona alu atu ai lea o le tasi auauna teine a le ositaulaga sili;

verses.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.sm: ua iloa e ia o Peteru o loo mumulu, ua na vaai atu foi ia te la, ua faapea atu, “O oe fci sa oulua faatasi ma Iesu le Nasareta.”

verses.en: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.sm: A o ia ua faafiti, ua faapea, “Ou te le iloa, ou te le lagona foi le mea ua e fai mai na.” Ona alu atu lea o ia i fafo i le faapaologa o le lotoā.

verses.en: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
verses.sm: Ua toe iloa o ia e le auauna teine, ona fai atu lea o ia i e va tutū mai, “O le tasi lena o i latou.” Ona toe faafiti lea o ia.

verses.en: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
verses.sm: Ua toe itiiti ona toe fai atu lea o e tutū mai ia Peteru, “E moni, o oe lava lo latou; auā o le Kalilaia oe.”

verses.en: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.sm: Ona augani lea o ia ma tauto, va faapea, “Ou te le iloa lava lea tagata tou te fai mai ai na.”

verses.en: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
verses.sm: Ona vivini faalua lea o moa. Ona manatua lea e Peteru o le upu na fetalai atu ai Iesu ia te ia, “E le vivini faalua moa, seia e faafiti faatolu mai ia te au.” Ona matuā tagi tele ai lea o ia.
